title: Margaret Anne Dyer
dates: (b.1857/8)
---

daughter of Alexander Macmillan

She married (1889) Louis Dyer (1851-1908), an American professor of Greek who settled in Oxford. She seems to have been a member of the Gosling Society, perhaps only for a short time. See the husband\'s obituary, The Times (21 July 1908).
